name: webcenter-readonly
description: Read-only access to Esko WebCenter for packaging engineers: projects, documents and ArtiosCAD designs, specs, approvals, thumbnails and downloads.
long_description: Uses the WebCenter SDK over HTTPS. Every tool is read-only: the server refuses to call any SDK page that changes data in WebCenter. The download tool saves files to a folder on this computer. Set the WebCenter address to 'mock' to try it with built-in sample data.

tools.name: webcenter_find_projects
tools.description: List projects or templates by scope, name, status or recent activity.

tools.name: webcenter_get_project
tools.description: One project's details: folders, attributes, characteristics, related projects.

tools.name: webcenter_list_documents
tools.description: Documents in a project with version, approval status and viewer link.

tools.name: webcenter_get_document_history
tools.description: Every version of a document with approval stages, decisions and comments.

tools.name: webcenter_get_attributes
tools.description: Specs/attributes on a project, document or task.

tools.name: webcenter_get_thumbnail
tools.description: Thumbnail image of a document or project.

tools.name: webcenter_download_document
tools.description: Download a document (e.g. an .ARD) to this computer.

tools.name: webcenter_get_todo_list
tools.description: Tasks and approvals waiting on a user.

tools.name: webcenter_find_users
tools.description: List users by type or name.

tools.name: webcenter_get_user
tools.description: One user's details, role and groups.

tools.name: webcenter_browse_characteristics
tools.description: The characteristics tree used to classify projects.

tools.name: webcenter_search
tools.description: Run a saved or new WebCenter search.

tools.name: webcenter_diagnostics_raw_response
tools.description: Troubleshooting: raw response of a read-only call.

base_url.title: WebCenter address
base_url.description: Your WebCenter site. Type mock to use built-in sample data instead.

username.title: Username
username.description: WebCenter username (a dedicated SDK user is best).

password.title: Password
password.description: WebCenter password. Stored in your system keychain.

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: Where downloaded WebCenter documents are saved. Leave empty for Downloads\WebCenter.

ssoiid.title: Basic login SSO instance ID (optional)
ssoiid.description: Only if your site uses single sign-on (SAML) by default: the ID of the basic password login from the 'SSO Instance Configuration' admin page.

allow_live.title: Allow live WebCenter
allow_live.description: Lets the server contact your real WebCenter. Turn off to block live calls.
